from PIL import Image
import json

img = Image.open('sample.jpg')
exif_data = img._getexif()

# Get the exact FocalLength value with full precision
from PIL.ExifTags import TAGS

for tag_id, value in exif_data.items():
    tag_name = TAGS.get(tag_id, tag_id)
    if tag_name == 'FocalLength':
        print(f"FocalLength type: {type(value)}")
        print(f"FocalLength value: {value}")
        if hasattr(value, 'numerator') and hasattr(value, 'denominator'):
            print(f"  As fraction: {value.numerator}/{value.denominator}")
            print(f"  As decimal: {float(value)}")
    elif tag_name == 'FocalLengthIn35mmFilm':
        print(f"\nFocalLengthIn35mmFilm type: {type(value)}")
        print(f"FocalLengthIn35mmFilm value: {value}")
EOF
uv run --offline --no-sync --project /opt/demo python check_precision.py", "description": "Check exact numeric precision of focal length values"}
